basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software engineer based in Seattle, enjoying the Pacific Northwest life. I have a passion for technology and humor, which is why you'll often find me in subreddits like Psychostick and ceph. When I'm not working, I love exploring the outdoors on my motorcycle or diving into DIY projects. I'm in a committed relationship and my partner and I are always on the lookout for new adventures. My online hours are mostly in the evenings after work. I also dabble in no-code solutions to streamline small projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Computer Science degree from the University of Washington and over a decade of experience in the tech industry. I regularly update my skills through online courses and self-directed learning. My interest in no-code platforms is a recent development, motivated by the desire to simplify processes in my side projects.
